derived_from: sync_fit --all --dry-run 20260929_152425: median of the 10 fits whose own rate SE < 0.5 ppm
_note: The camera-vs-Arduino clock drift rate (camera ticks per firmware ms; 1e6 = no drift) this rig shows across long sessions. sync_fit uses it instead of a session's own rate when that session cannot pin its rate to within 2 ppm (short or few matched LED edges); see docs/decisions/0209. Re-measure if the camera or the Arduino is replaced.
